questions.q: What did the narrator's mother give him the next day?
questions.explain: The mother gave the narrator a shiny new red cap the next day.

questions.q: How did the narrator feel when the wind blew away his cap?
questions.explain: The narrator cried a lot when his cap got stuck on a branch of a big old tree.

questions.q: What did the moon do after looking at the narrator's cap in the tree?
questions.explain: The moon smiled happily when it looked at the narrator's cap in the big old tree.

questions.q: What did the narrator's mother buy for the narrator?
questions.explain: The narrator's mother bought the narrator a bright blue cap.

questions.q: What event caused the narrator to cry and miss their dinner?
questions.explain: The strong wind blew the narrator's cap away, causing them to cry and miss their dinner.
